# Simple Medical Workforce Solutions

> Simple Medical Workforce Solutions is a healthcare staffing agency serving all of Southern California. It provides contract, per-diem, and direct placement for SNF, rehab centers, and hospitals, and connects healthcare professionals with roles. Founder and Chief Executive Officer: Dina Casares.

Service area: Serving all of Southern California
Regions: San Diego, Orange County, Los Angeles County, and the Inland Empire
Our primary focus is San Diego.
Facilities: For SNF, rehab centers, and hospitals
Address: 3333 Michelson Drive, Suite 300, Irvine, CA 92612, US
Phone: +1 (760) 536-2178
Email: info@simplemedicalstaffing.com

Services: contract staffing (seasonal census, leaves of absence, extended vacancies); per-diem staffing (call-outs, census spikes, weekend and night gaps); direct placement (permanent roles, hard-to-fill specialties, leadership).

Roles placed: Physical Therapist, Physical Therapy Aide, Occupational Therapist, Occupational Therapy Aide, Certified Nursing Assistant, Licensed Vocational Nurse, Registered Nurse, Respiratory Therapist, Speech Therapist, Caregiver.

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://simplemedicalstaffing.com/): Contract, per-diem, and direct placement staffing; overview for facilities and professionals.
- [Staffing Solutions](https://simplemedicalstaffing.com/solutions/): The three staffing models, who each is best for, and the four-step process from request to first shift.
- [For Professionals](https://simplemedicalstaffing.com/professionals/): Per-diem, contract, and permanent opportunities; the roles placed; what to expect from a coordinator.
- [About](https://simplemedicalstaffing.com/about/): Mission, values, and founder and CEO Dina Casares.
- [Contact](https://simplemedicalstaffing.com/contact/): Phone, email, and office address; what to include in a staffing request.
- [Request Staff](https://simplemedicalstaffing.com/request-staff/): For facilities: a link into the web app's staffing request form, with the phone and email as the other way in.
- [Apply Now](https://simplemedicalstaffing.com/apply/): How healthcare professionals apply online in the web app, or reach the team by phone or email; what not to send by email.

## Staffing Solutions in Detail

- [Contract Healthcare Staffing](https://simplemedicalstaffing.com/solutions/contract-staffing/): Longer-term placements for sustained coverage, matched to the unit and the team.
- [Per-Diem Healthcare Staffing](https://simplemedicalstaffing.com/solutions/per-diem-staffing/): Shift-by-shift coverage for call-outs, census spikes, and weekend and night gaps.
- [Direct Placement for Healthcare Facilities](https://simplemedicalstaffing.com/solutions/direct-placement/): Permanent healthcare hires selected for fit with the team.
- [Staffing Request Checklist for Facilities](https://simplemedicalstaffing.com/solutions/staffing-request-checklist/): What to include in a staffing request: unit, shift, specialty, start date.

- [Candidate FAQ for Healthcare Professionals](https://simplemedicalstaffing.com/professionals/faq/): How to apply, kinds of work available, roles placed, and what to expect from a coordinator.
